SELECT * FROM material_analysis_batch_items WHERE item_id = #{itemId} AND user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE material_analysis_batch_items SET upload_state = #{uploadState}, material_id = #{materialId}, message = #{message}, est_min_seconds = COALESCE(#{estMinSeconds}, est_min_seconds), est_max_seconds = COALESCE(#{estMaxSeconds}, est_max_seconds) WHERE item_id = #{itemId} AND user_id = #{userId}

UPDATE material_analysis_batches b SET b.status = 'ABANDONED', b.finished_at = NOW() WHERE b.status = 'STAGED' AND b.created_at < #{before} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT * FROM material_analysis_batch_items) i WHERE i.batch_id = b.batch_id AND i.material_id IS NOT NULL)
